column1: # Cheatsheet shown by scripts/cheatsheet.sh ($mod2+slash and the bar icon).

column3: Power menu: lock, logout, suspend, reboot, shutdown
i3 layout manager: save / restore window layouts
Command vault: pick a saved command, Enter copies it
Search the command vault, the command lands on the prompt
Command vault in a tmux popup, pasted into the pane
Save the typed line (save, save N: the last commands)
Record the terminal (asciinema), linked to a vault entry

column2: Alt + Shift + H / J / K / L
column3: Move the window left / down / up / right
Switch focus between floating and tiled
Hide in the scratchpad / show the scratchpad
Next / previous workspace on this screen
Move the workspace to the screen on the right
Gaps mode (+/- inner, Shift +/- outer, 0 resets)
Mouse mode: move the pointer with the keyboard (F/U click, D/I right click)
Pass-through mode: i3 ignores the keys (VMs, remote desktop), same keys to leave
Restart i3 (after changing screens or the config)
Click: RAM and swap usage, biggest processes
Click: connect, exit node, peers, copy IP (grey = off)
Click: take a break, restart, pause 1 h, rhythm (orange = break due)
Click: screen layouts (same as Super + M)
Click: power menu (same as Super + F)
